title: Psychological Decay Focus
rule: Emphasize the gradual mental collapse of the protagonist, where each strategic error intensifies paranoia, guilt, and self-reproach, which in turn subtly reshapes the manor as a reflection of his deteriorating psyche.

title: Structural Reality Feedback Loop
rule: Focus on the strict cause-effect loop where every miscalculation immediately and visibly alters a specific part of the manor, reinforcing the idea that reality itself is directly governed by his strategic thinking.

title: Haunted Competition Focus
rule: Emphasize the ghost of the final match as an active, almost opponent-like presence that observes, judges, and subtly influences the unfolding invisible game against the protagonist.

title: Inevitable Checkmate Tension
rule: Focus on the escalating inevitability of the final checkmate, where every mistake feels like a step toward a predetermined collapse of both manor and self.

title: Manor as Emotional Mirror
rule: Emphasize the manor as a direct emotional and psychological mirror of the protagonist’s internal state, where every regret manifests as architectural decay or distortion.

title: Invisible Game Literalization
rule: Emphazise how all life decisions of the protagonist must be reframed as moves in an invisible chess game with clearly implied but never directly visible rules.

title: Regret-Driven Reality Distortion
rule: Focus on regret as the causal force that warps reality, making past mistakes physically accumulate within the manor’s structure and atmosphere.

title: Isolation and Entropy Focus
rule: Emphasize increasing isolation as the manor becomes more distorted and hostile, reinforcing a sense of entropic collapse and psychological imprisonment.

title: Perception Unreliability Focus
rule: Focus on the protagonist’s inability to trust perception, as it becomes unclear whether manor changes are real, symbolic, or hallucinated consequences of his errors.

title: Time Pressure Escalation
rule: Emphasize the accelerating pace of consequences, where each mistake brings the manor closer to a final, irreversible structural collapse.

title: Self-Inflicted Opponent Focus
rule: Focus on the idea that the protagonist himself is both player and opponent in the invisible game, with every decision effectively acting as a move against his own survival.

title: Memory Contamination Focus
rule: Emphasize how mistakes not only alter the manor but also distort or overwrite the protagonist’s memories of the final match and his own identity.

title: Architectural Symbolism Focus
rule: Focus on specific architectural elements of the manor as symbolic representations of past strategic failures, each room or corridor embodying a different regret.

title: Fatal Intellect Escalation
rule: Emphasize the paradox that the protagonist’s greatest strength—strategic intelligence—is what accelerates his downfall through increasingly consequential decisions.

title: Aesthetic Decadence Focus
description: Focus on how the disintegration of priceless art and luxury mirrors his fallen social status.

title: Reality Fragility Focus
rule: Emphasize the fragility of reality itself, where minor strategic errors cause disproportionately large structural and existential consequences within the manor.

title: Guilt Externalization Focus
rule: Focus on guilt becoming externalized into physical space, turning emotional weight into tangible environmental distortion and decay.

title: Final Match Echo Dominance
rule: Emphasize the lingering influence of the final match as a dominating narrative force that continuously reasserts itself through every mistake and consequence.

title: Moral Accounting System
rule: Emphazise how every decision must implicitly be evaluated by an unseen system that translates ethical or emotional errors into structural damage.

title: Historical Revisionism Focus
rule: Emphasize how each blunder actively rewrites the real-world history of the grandmaster's career, turning past victories into public scandals and erasing his legacy as the manor decays.

title: Sacrificial Gambit Focus
rule: Focus on the protagonist's desperate need to intentionally sacrifice parts of his life, sanity, or the manor itself to prevent total collapse, framing survival as a series of brutal trade-offs.

title: Sensory Deprivation Escalation
rule: Emphasize the literal loss of sensory perception as the game progresses; with every major strategic error, the manor loses color, sound, or warmth, plunging the protagonist into a sterile, black-and-white void.
